question: Should appGuidedAuth and crestodian.setup.auth.start become supported provider-plugin and Gateway client contracts in this release?
rationale: The PR creates permanent compatibility-sensitive plugin and protocol surfaces under a protected maintainer label; repairing the concrete defects does not decide the long-term support commitment.

options.title: Repair, prove, and accept
options.body: Fix the lifecycle defect, document the contracts, add exact-head runtime proof, and support the generic provider-owned design.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Reduce provider breadth or public API exposure before committing to long-term compatibility.

options.title: Pause the expansion
options.body: Defer native provider sign-in and retain the current key and provider-CLI setup paths.

recommendation.title: Repair, prove, and accept
recommendation.body: Fix the lifecycle defect, document the contracts, add exact-head runtime proof, and support the generic provider-owned design.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged current-main work introduced the adjacent onboarding and plugin manifest surfaces, making them the strongest available owner for this contract decision.
